description: This file defines the SqlDatabaseChain class for integrating SQL database querying with language models, including initialization and run methods, and utility functions for creating database chains with custom prompts and moderation features.

classes.name: SqlDatabaseChain_Chains
classes.description: Implements a node for SQL database querying over language models, supporting initialization and execution with moderation and streaming capabilities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SQL database chain with parameters from node data, including database type, model, connection URL, tables, and custom prompt.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the SQL database chain with input, handling moderation, streaming, and callback mechanisms.
